title: HAXcms site.json
description: A HAXcms site manifest (site.json): core JSON Outline Schema plus the metadata conventions HAXcms reads and writes. Unknown keys inside `metadata.*` groups are allowed (HAXcms passes them through), but unknown top-level keys on items are rejected because HAXcms drops them on save.

booleanLike.description: Canonical form is a JSON boolean. Older HAXcms data stores flags as "1" / "0" / "" strings; readers should treat "1" and "true" as true and "", "0", "false" as false.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. Canonical form is an integer; numeric strings appear in older data.

location.description: HAXcms convention: `pages/<id>/index.html` (relative to the site root).

itemMetadata.description: Per-page metadata. Keys marked (computed) are recalculated by HAXcms from page content on save; writers can omit them.

published.description: Whether the page is published (visible to site visitors). Defaults to true when missing.

hideInMenu.description: Hide the page from site navigation while keeping it reachable by URL.

locked.description: Prevent editing of the page in the HAX editor.

tags.description: Page tags. site.json uses a comma-separated string; skeleton items use an array.

icon.description: Icon identifier (`iconset:name`, for example `icons:book`) used by themes in menus.

image.description: Featured image path or URL for the page.

images.description: (computed) Images referenced in the page content.

videos.description: (computed) Videos referenced in the page content.

files.description: (computed) Files referenced in the page content.

contentDetails.description: (computed) Content statistics (element / heading / paragraph counts, schema references).

overridePathauto.description: Keep the stored slug even when the site has `settings.pathauto` enabled.

author.description: Site author profile shown by themes.

build.description: How the site was originally created (written once by HAXcms at creation time).

name.description: Machine name of the site; matches its folder name under `_sites/`.

domain.description: Public domain the site is published to, if any.

homePageId.description: `id` of the item used as the home page.

version.description: HAXcms version that last wrote the site.

pathauto.description: Build slugs from the page title and parent path automatically.

element.description: Theme custom element tag, for example `clean-one`.

path.description: Module path of the theme, for example `@haxtheweb/clean-one/clean-one.js`.

styleGuide.description: External style-guide URL. When set, HAXcms treats style-guide editing as external.

regions.description: Theme region name -> array of item ids rendered in that region (for example `header`, `footerPrimary`).

platform.description: HAX editor / CMS behavior controls. See README 'How platform settings affect block behavior'.

audience.description: Editing audience. Defaults to `expert` when missing.

features.description: Feature toggles. A missing key means the feature is ENABLED; only an explicit `false` disables it.

allowedBlocks.description: Optional-block allow-list. Missing or `[]` = no allow-list defined (all blocks allowed). `null` = no optional blocks allowed. Non-empty array = only these tags (plus required primitive text tags).

delete.description: LEGACY: read as `features.deletePage`. Do not write.

blocks.description: LEGACY: read as `allowedBlocks`. Do not write.
